examples.arabic: طيب انا رايحه اشتري حاجات من السوق عايزة حاجه
examples.english: Okay, I'm going to buy some things from the market, do you want anything?
examples.transliteration: Tayeb ana rayha ashtiri hagat min es souq, ayza haga?

examples.arabic: طيب يا حبيبتي فين المكان الجديد ده
examples.english: Okay my dear. Where is this new place?
examples.transliteration: Tayeb ya habibty feen el makan el gedid da.

examples.arabic: طيب تشربي شاي ولا قهوة عندنا
examples.english: Okay, would you like to drink tea or coffee with us?
examples.transliteration: Tayeb, teshraaby shay wala ahwa andena?

examples.arabic: انا مش عارف كل حاجة
examples.english: I do not know everything.
examples.transliteration: ana mesh aref kol haga

examples.arabic: كريم رد انا بعمل أكلة هندية عارف انها صعبة بس متحمس اجربها
examples.english: Karim replied, "I'm making an Indian dish, I know it's hard but I'm excited to try it."
examples.transliteration: Karim radd ana ba'mel akla hindeya 'aref ennaha sa'ba bas motahames agarrabha.

examples.arabic: خفت شوية عشان مش عارف طريق البيت
examples.english: I felt a little scared because I didn't know the way to the house.
examples.transliteration: Khoft shwaya ashan mish aref taree' el bayt.

examples.arabic: إحنا بنحب أكل ماما كتير.
examples.english: We love Mom's food a lot.
examples.transliteration: E7na ben7ebb 2akl Mama ketir.
examples.storyTitle: An Egyptian Cooking Day in Our Home

examples.arabic: قعدنا نتكلم كتير عن أيامنا القديمة؛ كانت لحظات جميلة وسعيدة مع أصحابي.
examples.english: We sat talking a lot about our old days; they were beautiful and happy moments with my friends.
examples.transliteration: 2a3adna netkallem keteer 3an ayyamna el 2adima; kanet la7azat gameela w sa3eeda ma3 as7abi.

examples.arabic: أحمد اتمرن كتير كل يوم عشان يحسن إيده.
examples.english: Ahmed practiced a lot every day to improve his hand.
examples.transliteration: Ahmed itmarrin keteer kol yom ashan yihassin eedo.

examples.arabic: عمرنا ما هننسى أول مرة نشوف فيها التلج في شوارع نيويورك.
examples.english: We will never forget the first time we see snow in the streets of New York.
examples.transliteration: Omrena ma hanensa awel marra neshouf fiha el talg fi shawarea New York.

examples.arabic: أحمد مشي للمطعم الأول واداهم أربع شنط.
examples.english: Ahmed walked to the first restaurant and gave them four bags.
examples.transliteration: Ahmad meshi lel-matam el-awwal wa edahom arbaa shonat.

examples.arabic: النهاردة أول يوم في العيد الكبير في مصر.
examples.english: Today is the first day of the big holiday in Egypt.
examples.transliteration: En-naharda awwil yom fi el-eid el-kebir fi masr.
examples.storyTitle: War News on the Day of Eid

examples.arabic: خدت تليفونه عشان نتكلم أكتر الأيام الجاية
examples.english: I took his phone so we can talk more in the coming days.
examples.transliteration: Khaddt telefoono ashan netkallem aktar el ayam el gayya

examples.arabic: بعد ما لقتهم بالعافيه مسكت تفاحه بسرعه ونزلت تجري عشان متتأخرش اكتر على الشغل
examples.english: After she finally found them, she quickly grabbed an apple and ran down so she wouldn't be even more late for work.
examples.transliteration: Ba'd ma la'et'hom bel 'afya meseket toffaha besor'a we nizelet tegry ashan mateta'khargesh aktar ala el shoghl.

examples.arabic: انا بحب المكالمات اكتر وهو بيحب يبعت رسايل
examples.english: I like calls more and he likes to send messages
examples.transliteration: Ana bahebb el-mokalamaat aktar w howwa bihebb yib'at rasaayel
examples.storyTitle: A Phone Call with a Friend

examples.arabic: مصطفى: أيوه، أكيد عايز أروح معاكم.
examples.english: Mostafa: Yes, I definitely want to go with you (plural).
examples.transliteration: Mostafa: Aywa, akeed 3ayez aroo7 ma3akom.

examples.arabic: أحمد بيقول: 'أنا عايز شاي،' ومنى بتقول: 'أنا كمان بشرب شاي.' فبصب لهم الشاي في الكوبايات.
examples.english: Ahmed says: 'I want tea,' and Mona says: 'I also drink tea.' So I pour them the tea into the cups.
examples.transliteration: Ahmed byea2ul: 'Ana 3ayez shay,' w Mona bet2ul: 'Ana kaman bashrab shay.' Fa basobb lehom el shay fel kobbayat.

examples.arabic: أحمد قال أنا عايز اتنين كيلو تفاح أحمر لو سمحت.
examples.english: Ahmed said, I want two kilos of red apples, please.
examples.transliteration: Ahmed al ana ayez etnin kilo toffah ahmar law samaht.

examples.arabic: بابا قال: إحنا لازم نروح السوق النهاردة يا حلوين.
examples.english: Dad said: We must go to the market today, my dears.
examples.transliteration: Baba aal: Ehna lazam narouh el soo2 ennaharda ya helwein.

examples.arabic: انت لازم تجيب اكل صحي معاك في الطريق
examples.english: You must bring healthy food with you on the way
examples.transliteration: enta lazem tigueeb akl sehhi maak fi el tareeq

examples.arabic: مفيش وقت خلاص انا لازم انزل دلوقتي
examples.english: There's no time already I must go down now
examples.transliteration: Mafeesh wa't khalas ana lazim anzil dilwa'ti

examples.arabic: يلا بينا نشوف السلك طيب يمكن كلام تيتتي صح
examples.english: Come on, let's go check the cable then, maybe Teteti's words are right.
examples.transliteration: Yalla bina neshoof elsellk tayyeb yemken kalam Teteti sah

examples.arabic: الجد فاكر ان الكورة زمان كانت احسن
examples.english: The grandfather thinks that football in the past was better.
examples.transliteration: El ged faker en el kora zaman kanet ahsan

examples.arabic: يمكن بكرة أعمل أكل تاني يكون أحسن من ده
examples.english: Maybe tomorrow I'll make other food that's better than this.
examples.transliteration: Yomken bokra a'mel akl tani yekoon ahsan men da.

examples.arabic: انا باقول لا نشتري واحد جديد ده احسن
examples.english: I say "No, let's buy a new one, this is better".
examples.transliteration: Ana baqoul la neshtiri wahed gedeed da ahsan.

examples.arabic: النهاردة بنخطط لفرح حلو
examples.english: Today we are planning for a sweet wedding.
examples.transliteration: Elnaharda benkhattat le farah helw.

examples.arabic: يا رب نقضي وقت حلو تاني مع بعض كده كل يوم
examples.english: Oh God, I hope we spend sweet time together again like this every day.
examples.transliteration: ya rab na2ady wa2t 7elw tany ma3 ba3d keda koll yom
examples.storyTitle: A Warm Day at Our Home

examples.arabic: صوته بيبقى عالي لما يشوف فاكهة حمرا او اكل حلو
examples.english: His voice gets loud when he sees red fruit or sweet food.
examples.transliteration: Soto byeb'a 'aali lamma yeshoof fakha hamra aw akl helw

examples.arabic: رد: "لا، فيه قهوة مظبوط بخمسة جنيه، عادي."
examples.english: He replied: "No, there is medium coffee for five pounds, normal."
examples.transliteration: Radd: "La, fih ahwa mazbout bekhamsa geneh, aadi."

examples.arabic: الجد استغرب من اسئلته الحاجات دي كانت عادي بالنسبة له
examples.english: The grandfather was surprised by his questions; these things were normal for him.
examples.transliteration: El-gadd istaghrab min as'ilto, el-ḥagāt di kanet 3ādi bel-nesba lo.

examples.arabic: هيتكلم بعدين، عادي.
examples.english: He will speak later, it's normal.
examples.transliteration: Hayitkallim ba'dein, a'adi.

examples.arabic: كل يوم بلبس نفس الهدوم
examples.english: Every day I wear the same clothes.
examples.transliteration: Kol yom balbes nafs el hedoom.

examples.arabic: كل واحد بيعمل حاجة مختلفة لكن كلهم في نفس القهوة
examples.english: Everyone does something different, but they are all in the same café.
examples.transliteration: Koll wahed biy3amal haga mokhtalefa lakin kolluhom fi nafs el-ahwa.

examples.arabic: انا رايح الشغل كل يوم في نفس المعاد
examples.english: I'm going to work every day at the same time.
examples.transliteration: Ana rayeh el shoghl kolle yoom fi nafs el me'aad.

examples.arabic: بعدين رجعوا بيتهم الجميل مبسوطين جداً.
examples.english: Then they returned to their beautiful house, very happy.
examples.transliteration: Ba3dein reg'ou beithom el gamil mabsootein geddan.

examples.arabic: الجو كان جميل أوي الصبح في حتتنا.
examples.english: The weather was very beautiful this morning in our neighborhood.
examples.transliteration: El gaw kan gameel awi el sobh fi 7atetna.
examples.storyTitle: A Beautiful Day in Our Neighborhood

examples.arabic: السوق كان جميل أوي وفيه ناس كتير.
examples.english: The market was very beautiful and had many people.
examples.transliteration: El sooq kan gamil awi w fih nas ktir.

examples.arabic: صباح النور يا سارة الحمد لله بخير انتي عاملة ايه
examples.english: Good morning, Sara, praise be to God, I'm fine. How are you?
examples.transliteration: Sabah el noor ya Sara, alhamdulillah bekheir, enti aamla eih?

examples.arabic: انا قلت الحمد لله انا بخير
examples.english: I said, "Praise be to God, I am fine."
examples.transliteration: Ana olt el hamdulillah ana bikheir.

examples.arabic: رد احمد وقالي الحمد لله بخير انت اللي عامل ايه يا صاحبي
examples.english: Ahmed replied and told me, "Praise be to God, I'm fine. How are you, my friend?"
examples.transliteration: Radd Ahmed w-qali "Elhamdullah bikheir, enta elli aamel eh ya saahbi?"

examples.arabic: ريحة العيش البلدي حلوة قوي
examples.english: The smell of the local bread is very sweet
examples.transliteration: reehet el eish el baladi helwa awy

examples.arabic: انا ببص من الشباك وبحلم احلام حلوة عن الشتا
examples.english: I am looking out the window and dreaming sweet dreams about the winter.
examples.transliteration: Ana babos men el shibbak wa bahlam ahlam helwa an el sheta.

examples.arabic: شربنا شاي سخن واكلنا حاجة حلوة
examples.english: We drank hot tea and ate a sweet thing.
examples.transliteration: sherebna shay sokhn we akalna haga helwa

examples.arabic: بابا بيقول إن الموضوع محتاج حكم كويس زي حكم القضاء
examples.english: My dad says the matter needs good judgment like the judgment of the judiciary.
examples.transliteration: Bābā biyʾūl en el-mawḍūʿ meḥtāg ḥokm kowayyes zayy ḥokm el-qaḍāʾ.

examples.arabic: يوسف: الحمد لله، أنا كويس. وإنت عامل إيه؟
examples.english: Youssef: Praise be to God, I'm good. And how are you doing?
examples.transliteration: Youssef: Elhamdulillah, ana kwayyes. We enta 3amel eh?

examples.arabic: ماما بتجيب أكل كويس أوي لغدانا.
examples.english: Mom brings very good food for our lunch.
examples.transliteration: Mama bitgeeb akl kwayis awi lighadana.
examples.storyTitle: War News on the Day of Eid

examples.arabic: انا عاوز اروح محطة المترو هي فين
examples.english: I want to go to the metro station, where is it?
examples.transliteration: Ana 'awiz arouh mahattet el-metro, heya feen?

examples.arabic: أحمد مشي للمطعم الأول واداهم أربع شنط.
examples.english: Ahmed walked to the first restaurant and gave them four bags.
examples.transliteration: Ahmad meshi lel-matam el-awwal wa edahom arbaa shonat.

examples.arabic: ما عرفتش مين ده في الاول علشان شكله اتغير قبل ما يقرب مني
examples.english: I did not know who this was at first because his appearance changed before he got closer to me.
examples.transliteration: ma araftesh meen da fel awal alashan shaklo etghayar abl ma yearab meny

examples.arabic: في الاول حسيت اني كسلان ومش مبسوط
examples.english: At first, I felt lazy and not happy.

examples.arabic: كل يوم بنصحى بدري عشان نخطط للفرح الكبير
examples.english: Every day we wake up early to plan for the big wedding.
examples.transliteration: Koll yōm bansaa badry ʿashān nokhaṭṭeṭ lel-faraḥ el-kabīr.

examples.arabic: ركبوا العربية بتاعتهم وراحوا السوق الكبير في القاهرة.
examples.english: They got into their car and went to the big market in Cairo.
examples.transliteration: Rakbou el 3arabeya beta3ethom we rahou el soo2 el kebir fi el Qahera.

examples.arabic: أحمد راح السوق الكبير في القاهرة امبارح.
examples.english: Ahmed went to the big market in Cairo yesterday.
examples.transliteration: Ahmed rah el sooq el kebir fel Qahera embareh.

examples.arabic: ماما كانت بتقول مش عارفة يا حبيبي
examples.english: Mom used to say 'I don't know, my dear'
examples.transliteration: Mama kanet bet'oul mish 'arfa ya habibi

examples.arabic: طب كويس بس مين انتي انا مش عارفة مين انتي
examples.english: Okay, that's good, but who are you? I don't know who you are.
examples.transliteration: Tab kwayyes, bass meen enti? Ana mish 'arfa meen enti?

examples.arabic: جدتي عايزة تعمل اكل كتير عشان عارفة اني جعان
examples.english: My grandmother wants to cook a lot of food because she knows I am hungry.
examples.transliteration: Gaddeti ayza taamel akl kiteer ashan arfa enni gaaan

examples.arabic: عندنا فرح سعيد للكل
examples.english: We have a happy wedding for everyone.
examples.transliteration: 'Andena farah sa'eed lel-kol.

examples.arabic: انا سعيد جداً اني هنا في السوق
examples.english: I am very happy that I am here in the market.
examples.transliteration: Ana sa'eed giddan inni hena fil souq.

examples.arabic: بخلص المدرسة وبروح البيت سعيد
examples.english: I finish school and go home happy.
examples.transliteration: Bakhalas el madrasa w baro7 el beit sa3eed.

examples.arabic: كريم اتفاجئ وحاول ينكر اي حاجة غلط
examples.english: Karim was surprised and tried to deny anything wrong.
examples.transliteration: Karim etfage' we hawel yenker ay haga ghalat.

examples.arabic: بس بعد كده عرفنا اننا في الماتش الغلط
examples.english: But then we realized we were at the wrong match
examples.transliteration: Bas ba'd keda 'arefna ennena fil-match el-ghalat

examples.arabic: اخيرا شفتها جاية وبتضحك كانها معملتش حاجة غلط
examples.english: Finally, I saw her coming and laughing as if she hadn't done anything wrong.
examples.transliteration: Akheeran shoftaha gayya we betḍaḥḥak ka'ennaha ma3melitsh ḥaaga ghalaṭ
examples.storyTitle: The Cafe Appointment That Never Ends

examples.arabic: أنا حسيت إن قلبي بيتنطط من السعادة في وسط الجو الجديد ده.
examples.english: I felt that my heart was jumping from happiness in the middle of this new atmosphere.
examples.transliteration: Ana hasset en alby beyetnattat men el saada fi wast el gaw el gedid da.

examples.arabic: كنت عايز اروح المطعم الجديد
examples.english: I wanted to go to the new restaurant
examples.transliteration: kont ayez arouh el mataam el gedid

examples.arabic: النهاردة انا بطبخ اكل جديد في المطبخ
examples.english: Today I am cooking new food in the kitchen.
examples.transliteration: elneharda ana batbokh akl gediid fi elmatbakh

examples.arabic: اه معايا عايز اغيره بواحد اكبر
examples.english: Yes I have it, I want to exchange it for a bigger one.
examples.transliteration: ah ma3aya 3ayez aghayyaroh bewahed akbar

examples.arabic: مصطفى: ماشي يا يوسف، أشوفك بكرة!
examples.english: Mostafa: Okay, Youssef, see you tomorrow!
examples.transliteration: Mostafa: Mashi ya Youssef, ashoofak bokra!

examples.arabic: قلت له ماشي هنتقابل بالليل
examples.english: I told him okay we will meet at night.
examples.transliteration: olt loh mashy hantabel bellel

examples.arabic: هو قالي ماشي شكرا واقفلنا السكة
examples.english: He told me, "Okay, thank you," and we hung up.
examples.transliteration: howwa ally mashy shokran w affelna el-sekka

examples.arabic: المفروض نلاقي حاجة الكل يستمتع بيها
examples.english: We are supposed to find something everyone enjoys.
examples.transliteration: El-mafrūḍ nilā'ī ḥāgah el-kull yestamte' bīhā.

examples.arabic: الدنيا بتمطر كتير النهارده وانا قاعد في البيت مع عيلتي
examples.english: It is raining a lot today and I am sitting in the house with my family.
examples.transliteration: El donya betmatar keteer ennaharda wana aed fel beit ma eiltey.

examples.arabic: انا قاعد في القهوة دلوقتي وبشرب شاي
examples.english: I am sitting in the café now and drinking tea.
examples.transliteration: ana aed fel ahwa delwati we bashrab shay

examples.arabic: جدي قاعد على الكرسي وبيشرب شاي
examples.english: Grandpa is sitting on the chair and drinking tea.
examples.transliteration: gedi aed ala elkorsi webyeshrab shay

examples.arabic: اه معلش الكورة طارت بعيد اوي
examples.english: Oh, never mind, the ball flew very far.
examples.transliteration: Ah ma'alesh el koora tarat ba'eed awi.

examples.arabic: الجدة عايزة مكان هادي جدا بعيد عن الناس
examples.english: Grandma wants a very quiet place far from people.
examples.transliteration: El gedda ayza makan hady geddan ba'eed 'an el nas.

examples.arabic: سالت راجل لو سمحت الماركت هنا ولا بعيد
examples.english: I asked a man: 'Excuse me, is the market here or far?'
examples.transliteration: Sa'alt ragel: 'Law samaht, el-market hena walla ba'eed?'

examples.arabic: جدي مش فاهم الحاجة دي وفاكر ان اخويا بيلعب
examples.english: My grandpa does not understand this thing and thinks that my brother is playing.
examples.transliteration: Geddi mesh fahem el haga di wa faker en akhouya biyelab.

examples.arabic: جدي مش فاهم التليفون الجديد ده
examples.english: Grandfather does not understand this new phone.
examples.transliteration: geddy mish fahem el telephone el gedid da

examples.arabic: يا إلهي هل ده أكل ولا إيه أنا لسة مش فاهم
examples.english: Oh my god, is this food or what? I still don't understand.
examples.transliteration: Ya elahy hal da akl wala eih ana lessa mesh fahem.

examples.arabic: انا مستني صاحبي بس هو مش جاي
examples.english: I am waiting for my friend, but he is not coming.
examples.transliteration: Ana mestanni sahbi bas howa mish gay.

examples.arabic: هو قال حاضر شكرا انا جاي مع السلامة
examples.english: He said, "Okay, thank you! I'm coming. Goodbye."
examples.transliteration: Howa qal ḥader shukran ana gay ma3 el salama.

examples.arabic: انا قلت له كويس اوي انا جاي دلوقتي
examples.english: I told him: "Very good, I'm coming now."
examples.transliteration: Ana oltelo kwayyes awy ana gay delwaqti.

examples.arabic: السوق قريب اوي من بيتي
examples.english: The market is very close to my house.
examples.transliteration: el souk arib awi men beity

examples.arabic: هو وراني الطريق وقالي انه قريب من البيت
examples.english: He showed me the way and told me it's close to the house.
examples.transliteration: Huwa warrany el taree' we 'aly eno 'areeb men el bayt.

examples.arabic: انا كويس الحمد لله بيتي قريب من هنا تحب تشرب مايه
examples.english: "I'm good, thank God. My house is close by. Would you like to drink some water?"
examples.transliteration: Ana kowayyes el-hamdu lellah. Beyti 'arayyeb men hena. Tehebb teshrob mayya?

examples.arabic: صاحبي مش موجود
examples.english: My friend is not here (present).
examples.transliteration: Sahbi mish mawgoud.

examples.arabic: نزلت تشوف البواب عم سعيد موجود.
examples.english: She went down to see if the doorman Uncle Saeed was present.
examples.transliteration: Nezelet teshof el bawab amm Saeed mawgood.

examples.arabic: أمي بتقولي إن اختيار الفستان زي اختيار رئيس الجمهورية صعب
examples.english: My mom tells me that choosing the dress is as difficult as choosing the President of the Republic.
examples.transliteration: Ommi betʾūli en ekhtiyār el-fostān zayy ekhtiyār raʾīs el-gomhūrīya ṣaʿb.

examples.arabic: بابا بيشرح إن الوضع صعب أوي و قديم.
examples.english: Dad explains that the situation is very difficult and old.
examples.transliteration: Baba biyishrah in el-wad saab awi wa adeem.
examples.storyTitle: War News on the Day of Eid

examples.arabic: في الشوط التاني اللعب بقى صعب بس اللعيبة كانوا بيجروا بسرعة
examples.english: In the second half, the game got difficult but the players were running quickly.
examples.transliteration: fe el showt el tany el le3b ba2a sa3b bas el le3eeba kano beyegrou besor3a
examples.storyTitle: The National Team Match with the Family

examples.arabic: منى، الطالبة اللي عندها 22 سنة ودايماً بتنسى حاجات، افتكرت فجأة إنها مجبورة تسافر بكير للقاهرة ونسيت أهم كتاب للدرس في بيت أبوها.
examples.english: Mona, the 22-year-old student who always forgets things, suddenly remembered that she was forced to travel early to Cairo and forgot the most important book for the lesson at her father's house.
examples.transliteration: Mona, el-taliba elly 'andaha 22 sana we-daayman betensa hagaat, eftekaret faga'a ennaha magboora tesaafer bakkeer lel-Qahira we-nesyet aham ketaab lel-dars fe beet aboo-ha.

examples.arabic: بس احنا اصررنا ان اهم حاجة يبقى في مخلل كتير مع كل طبق بتاعنا
examples.english: But we insisted that the most important thing is to have a lot of pickles with every dish of ours.
examples.transliteration: Bas ehna asrarna en aham haga yeb2a fe mekhalil keteer ma3 kol taba2 beta3na.
examples.storyTitle: The Wedding Party and the Pickles

examples.arabic: ضحكنا وقلنا اهم حاجه اننا بنحب الاكل الصحي حتى لو غالي
examples.english: We laughed and said 'The most important thing is that we love healthy food, even if it's expensive.'
examples.transliteration: Deheknā w olna 'Aham haga ennena benhebb el-akl el-sehhy hatta law ghaly.'

examples.arabic: بنتهم نورا بتحب ترسم صور جميلة.
examples.english: Their daughter, Nora, loves to draw beautiful pictures.
examples.transliteration: Bentehom Nora bethebb tersom sowar gamila.

examples.arabic: في السوق، شافوا فواكه وخضروات بألوان كتير جميلة.
examples.english: In the market, they saw many fruits and vegetables with beautiful colors.
examples.transliteration: Fel soo2, shafou fawakeh we khodarwat be alwan ketir gamila.

examples.arabic: كان فيه بيت صغير في حارة جميلة.
examples.english: There was a small house in a beautiful alley.
examples.transliteration: Kan fih beit soghayar fi 7ara gamila.
examples.storyTitle: Karim's Ball and the Neighborhood Friends

examples.arabic: القميص حلو اوي بس غالي
examples.english: The shirt is very nice but expensive.
examples.transliteration: el amees helw awy bas ghaly

examples.arabic: بس القميص كان غالي اوي
examples.english: But the shirt was very expensive.
examples.transliteration: bas el amiis kaan ghaali awi

examples.arabic: الطماطم رخيصة بس العيش غالي
examples.english: The tomatoes are cheap but the bread is expensive.
examples.transliteration: el tomatem rkheesa bas el eish ghaly

examples.arabic: منى بتشتري هدوم جديدة لعرايس نورا.
examples.english: Mona buys new clothes for Nora's dolls.
examples.transliteration: Mona beteshtari hedoom gedida le 3arayes Nora.

examples.arabic: لبست هدومها الجديدة لونها أزرق.
examples.english: She put on her new blue clothes.
examples.transliteration: Lebset hedoumaha el gedida lonha azra'.

examples.arabic: امبارح قعدنا مع بعض واتكلمنا عن أحلامنا الجديدة.
examples.english: Yesterday we sat together and talked about our new dreams.
examples.transliteration: Embareh aadna maa baad we etkallamna aan ahlamna el gedida.

examples.arabic: أنا وصحابي عايزين نشوف المنتخب في الماتش النهائي.
examples.english: My friends and I want to see the national team in the final match.
examples.transliteration: Ana wa sahabi ayzin neshouf el montakhab fel matsh el neha'i.

examples.arabic: كنا عايزين نشوف التلج لأول مرة في حياتنا عشان مش بنشوفه خالص في القاهرة.
examples.english: We wanted to see the snow for the first time in our lives because we never see it at all in Cairo.
examples.transliteration: Konna ayzin neshouf el talg le awel marra fi hayatna ashan mesh benshoufo khales fi el kahera.

examples.arabic: الرؤساء عايزين سلطة و سيطرة في المنطقة.
examples.english: The presidents want power and control in the region.
examples.transliteration: El-ruasa ayzin sulta wa saytara fi el-mantiqa.
examples.storyTitle: War News on the Day of Eid

examples.arabic: انا شايف طماطم حمرا ولمون اصفر
examples.english: I see red tomatoes and yellow lemons
examples.transliteration: ana shayef tamatem hamra we lamoon asfar

examples.arabic: شايف المطر بره الشباك
examples.english: I see the rain outside the window.
examples.transliteration: Shayef el matar barra el shobak

examples.arabic: شايف شجرة كبيرة برا وناس كتير بتتكلم
examples.english: I see a big tree outside and many people talking.
examples.transliteration: Shayef shagara kebeera barra we nas kiteer betetkallem.

examples.arabic: طبعاً يا بنتي، خليهم. الشاي بتاعنا مشهور، يبقى عظيم وبنقترحه.
examples.english: Of course, my daughter, keep them. Our tea is famous, it will be great, and we recommend it.
examples.transliteration: Tab'an ya benti, khalleehom. Esh-shay beta'na mashhoor, yeb'a 3azeem waben'tare7o.

examples.arabic: خليهم يلعبوا على البحر براحتهم و يبقى يوم عظيم لينا كلنا
examples.english: Let them play on the beach freely, and it will be a great day for all of us.
examples.transliteration: Khaleehom yel3abo 3al ba7r bara7ethom w yeb2a yom 3azeem leena kollena.

examples.arabic: عمر فرح وقال: عظيم يا عم، متشكرين خالص، مع السلامة!
examples.english: Omar was happy and said: 'Great, uncle, thanks a lot, goodbye!'
examples.transliteration: Omar faraḥ wi 'al: '3azeem ya 3amm, mitshakkerin khalis, ma3 es-salama!'

examples.arabic: كل واحد في الحتة كان حاسس بفرحة كبيرة عشان الفريق كان بيلعب كويس.
examples.english: Every person in the area was feeling a great joy because the team was playing well.
examples.transliteration: Kol wahed fel hetta kan hases be farha kebira ashan el fariq kan beyelab kways.

examples.arabic: هو كان حاسس بشوية قلق عشان مكنش عنده خبرة.
examples.english: He was feeling a bit of anxiety because he didn't have experience.
examples.transliteration: Huwa kan hassis bi shewayyet alaq ashan ma-kansh ando khibra.

examples.arabic: هو حاسس إنه مبسوط قوي عشان هو بيتعلم كتير.
examples.english: He feels very happy because he is learning a lot.
examples.transliteration: Huwa hases inu mabsut awi ashan huwa biyitalem ketir.

examples.arabic: اكيد بابا هو مرشحنا الوحيد للمشاكل دي في البيت
examples.english: Of course Dad, he's our only candidate for these problems at home.
examples.transliteration: Akīd baba, howa morashshaḥna el-waḥīd lel-mashākel dī fel-bēt.

examples.arabic: فريقي كسب الماتش المهم ده
examples.english: My team won this important match.
examples.transliteration: Fareeqy keseb el match el mohem da

examples.arabic: سارة قالت أنا هروق الشقة وأجهز الغدا بدري عشان عندي مشوار مهم
examples.english: Sara said: I will tidy the apartment and prepare lunch early because I have an important errand.
examples.transliteration: Sara qalet ana ha-rawwaq el-shaqqa w aghahhez el-ghada badri ashan andi meshwar mohem.

examples.arabic: صباح النور يا مدام سارة معلش عندي مشوار مهم ومحدش فاضي يوصلني
examples.english: Good morning, Mrs. Sara, sorry, I have an important errand and no one is free to drive me.
examples.transliteration: Sabah el noor ya madam Sara, ma'lesh 'andy meshwar mohem we mahaddesh fady yewassalny.

examples.arabic: بعدين رجعوا بيتهم الجميل مبسوطين جداً.
examples.english: Then they returned to their beautiful house, very happy.
examples.transliteration: Ba3dein reg'ou beithom el gamil mabsootein geddan.

examples.arabic: اشتريت الحاجات اللي عايزها ورجعت البيت مبسوطة من الزحمة والجو الجميل
examples.english: I bought the things I wanted and returned home happy with the crowd and the beautiful atmosphere.
examples.transliteration: Eshtarēt el-ḥāgāt elly ʿāyezha we regaʿt el-beit mabsūṭa men ez-zaḥma wel-gaww el-gamīl.
examples.storyTitle: A Trip to the Popular Market

examples.arabic: روحنا نزور عمتي منى في بيتها الجميل
examples.english: We went to visit my Aunt Mona at her beautiful home.
examples.transliteration: Rohna nizor ameti Mona fi bet'ha elgameel

examples.arabic: شفت راجل كبير محترم وقولتله بعد اذنك يا عمو
examples.english: I saw a respectable older man and said to him, 'Excuse me, uncle.'
examples.transliteration: Shoft ragel kibeer mohtaram we oltello ba'd eznek ya 'ammo

examples.arabic: “مش عارفين نعمل إيه؟” قال أحمد.
examples.english: "We don't know what to do?" Ahmed said.
examples.transliteration: “Mesh 3arfin na3mel eh?” al Ahmed.
examples.storyTitle: Karim's Ball and the Neighborhood Friends

examples.arabic: انا وبابا في العربية ومش عارفين الشارع
examples.english: My dad and I are in the car and we do not know the street.
examples.transliteration: ana wa baba fi el aarabeya wa mesh aarefeen el shareaa

examples.arabic: مارك قاله انا فاكر انت مصري بس بتعرف تعمل كل حاجة
examples.english: Mark told him, "I remember you are Egyptian, but you know how to make everything."
examples.transliteration: Mark 'alo ana faker enta masry bas bete'raf te'mel kol haga.

examples.arabic: وفي الاخر اكتشفت ان اللي قدامي ده مش احمد اصلا ده توأمه اللي كان عايش بره البلد
examples.english: And in the end, I discovered that the person in front of me wasn't Ahmed at all, but his twin brother who had been living abroad
examples.transliteration: We fel akher ektashaft enn elli oddaami da mesh Ahmed aslan da taw'amo elli kaan 'aayesh barra el balad

examples.arabic: لما روحت البيت اكتشفت ان خالي اصلا عايش في اسوان ومحتاجش جواكت
examples.english: When I went home, I discovered that my uncle actually lives in Aswan and doesn't need jackets.
examples.transliteration: lamma rowwaḥt il-beet iktashaft in khaali aṣlan 3aayish fi Aswan w ma-ḥtaagsh gawaakit

examples.arabic: صوته كان واضح وسمعته بيضحك
examples.english: His voice was clear and I heard him laughing
examples.transliteration: Soto kan wadeh w same3to beyedhak

examples.arabic: الراجل في المحل بص على الجاكت واِعْترف إن فيه عيب واضح
examples.english: The man in the shop looked at the jacket and admitted that there was a clear defect.
examples.transliteration: ir-raagil fil-maħall baṣṣ ʕala l-gakkit wi-3táraf inn fee ʕeeb waaɖeħ.

examples.arabic: انا قلت الحمد لله كويسة وصوتها كان واضح جدا
examples.english: I said "Praise be to God, I'm fine" and her voice was very clear.
examples.transliteration: Ana olt el hamdulillah kwayyesa w sotaha kan wade'h geddan

examples.arabic: احمد خد القميص و راح المحل التاني
examples.english: Ahmed took the shirt and went to the other shop.
examples.transliteration: Ahmed khad el amees wa raah el mahal el tani

examples.arabic: كلنا قعدنا حوالين الترابيزة الكبيرة عشان ناكل سوا والكل بيسال على حال التاني
examples.english: We all sat around the big table to eat together, and everyone was asking about each other's well-being.
examples.transliteration: Kollena qa3adna hawalein el tarabeeza el kebeera ashan nakol sawa wel koll beyessal 3ala hal el tani

examples.arabic: قعدنا نتكلم شوية عن شغلنا وحياتنا وكل واحد فينا حكى التاني عمل ايه
examples.english: We sat and talked a bit about our work and lives, and each of us told the other what they had been doing
examples.transliteration: Qa'adna netkallem shwaya 'an shoghlana w hayaatna we koll wahed feena haka el taany 'amel eh

examples.arabic: أنا حسيت إن قلبي بيتنطط من السعادة في وسط الجو الجديد ده.
examples.english: I felt that my heart was jumping from happiness in the middle of this new atmosphere.
examples.transliteration: Ana hasset en alby beyetnattat men el saada fi wast el gaw el gedid da.

examples.arabic: كنت عايز اروح المطعم الجديد
examples.english: I wanted to go to the new restaurant
examples.transliteration: kont ayez arouh el mataam el gedid

examples.arabic: جدي مش فاهم التليفون الجديد ده
examples.english: Grandfather does not understand this new phone.
examples.transliteration: geddy mish fahem el telephone el gedid da

examples.arabic: أحمد كان مبسوط أوي عشان قراره السريع أنقذ شغله النهاردة.
examples.english: Ahmed was very happy because his quick decision saved his work today.
examples.transliteration: Ahmad kan mabsoot awi ashan qararo el-saree ankaz shoghlo el-naharda.

examples.arabic: على مدار الوقت، رسمه اتحسن وبقى مبسوط أوي.
examples.english: Over time, his drawing improved and he became very happy.
examples.transliteration: Ala madar el wa-t, rasmo ethassan we ba-a mabsoot awi.

examples.arabic: دلوقتي هو مبسوط وانا كمان مبسوط
examples.english: Now he is happy and I am also happy
examples.transliteration: delwaaty howa mabsoot wa ana kaman mabsoot

examples.arabic: بس اخويا الصغير زعلان
examples.english: But my young brother is upset.
examples.transliteration: bas akhouya elsoghayer zaalan

examples.arabic: أنا زعلان شوية
examples.english: I am a little upset.
examples.transliteration: Ana za'lan shwaya

examples.arabic: منى كانت زعلانة قوي، بس أحمد فضل قوي.
examples.english: Mona was very sad, but Ahmed stayed strong.
examples.transliteration: Mona kanet za3lana awi, bas Ahmad fadl awi.

examples.arabic: ابن عمنا جاب لنا تلات بالطي تقيلة عشان البرد كان قوي جداً في الشوارع.
examples.english: Our cousin brought us three heavy coats because the cold was very strong in the streets.
examples.transliteration: Ebn ammena gab lena talat balaty te'ila ashan el bard kan awi geddan fi el shawarea.

examples.arabic: صوت المطر كان قوي والجو كان بارد شوية
examples.english: The sound of the rain was strong and the weather was a bit cold
examples.transliteration: Soot el matar kaan qawi wel gaw kaan bared shwayya

examples.arabic: السجادة كلها وسخة وعايزة تتنضف
examples.english: The whole carpet is dirty and needs to be cleaned.
examples.transliteration: El saggada kolaha wesekha w ayza tetnaddaf.

examples.arabic: فجاة سمعنا صوت غريب من المطبخ
examples.english: Suddenly we heard a strange sound from the kitchen.
examples.transliteration: Fagaa sameana soot ghareeb men el matbakh

examples.arabic: لما الاكل استوى شكله كان غريب اكيد مش زي اللي شفته
examples.english: When the food was cooked, its appearance was strange, definitely not like what I saw.
examples.transliteration: Lamma el akl estawa shakloh kan ghareeb akeed mesh zayy elly shoftoh.
examples.storyTitle: A Dish I Cooked for the First Time

examples.arabic: الطبق كان شكله غريب جدا مش زي الصورة خالص
examples.english: The dish looked very strange, not like the picture at all.
examples.transliteration: El tabaq kan shaklo ghareeb geddan mesh zayy el soora khales.

examples.arabic: حبهم بيخلي بيتهم الصغير بيت دافي.
examples.english: Their love makes their small house a warm home.
examples.transliteration: Hobbehom byekhalli beithom el soghayar beit dafi.

examples.arabic: كان فيه بيت صغير في حارة جميلة.
examples.english: There was a small house in a beautiful alley.
examples.transliteration: Kan fih beit soghayar fi 7ara gamila.
examples.storyTitle: Karim's Ball and the Neighborhood Friends

examples.arabic: امبارح، اتنين من أصحابي، أحمد ومنى، وصلوا بيتي الصغير.
examples.english: Yesterday, two of my friends, Ahmed and Mona, arrived at my small house.
examples.transliteration: Embare7, etneen men as7abi, Ahmed w Mona, wasalo beity el soghayyar.

examples.arabic: الفاكهاني إداله الفاكهة في شنطة كبيرة.
examples.english: The fruit seller gave him the fruit in a big bag.
examples.transliteration: El fakaheni edalo el faka fi shanta kebira.

examples.arabic: نزلنا نلعب كلنا وعملنا خمس كور تلج كبيرة ورميناهم على بعض.
examples.english: We all went down to play and made five big snowballs and threw them at each other.
examples.transliteration: Nezelna nel'ab kollona we amalna khamas kowar talg kebira we rameenahom ala ba'ad.

examples.arabic: في يوم، كان عنده تلاتة طلبات كبيرة لمطاعم مختلفة.
examples.english: One day, he had three big orders for different restaurants.
examples.transliteration: Fi yom, kan ando talaata talabat kebira le-mataem mokhtalifa.

examples.arabic: هو كان طيب جدا و وراني الطريق الصح و حسيت براحة كبيرة
examples.english: He was very kind and showed me the correct way, and I felt great relief.
examples.transliteration: Howa kan tayeb geddan we warrani el taree' el sa7 we hassait be ra7a kebeera.

examples.arabic: دلوقتي اقدر اشتري الكتاب الصح اللي كنت بدور عليه
examples.english: Now I can buy the correct book I was looking for.
examples.transliteration: Delwaʾty aqdar eshtari el-ketāb es-saḥḥ elly kont badawwar ʿalēh.

examples.arabic: كنت سعيدة اوي اني سمعت صوتها الحلو
examples.english: I was very happy that I heard her sweet voice.
examples.transliteration: Kunt sa'eeda awi enni sama't sotaha el helw

examples.arabic: فتحت الباب و سمعت صوتها الحلو
examples.english: I opened the door and heard her sweet voice.
examples.transliteration: fataht el-bab we sema't sot-ha el-helw

examples.arabic: الضحك والكلام الحلو مال البيت والقلوب كانت فرحانة بلمة العيلة دي
examples.english: Laughter and sweet talk filled the house, and hearts were happy with this family gathering.
examples.transliteration: El-dehk wel-kalam el-helw mal el-beit wel-'oloub kanet farhana belammet el-'eila di

examples.arabic: كل يوم بنصحى بدري عشان نخطط للفرح الكبير
examples.english: Every day we wake up early to plan for the big wedding.
examples.transliteration: Koll yōm bansaa badry ʿashān nokhaṭṭeṭ lel-faraḥ el-kabīr.

examples.arabic: ركبوا العربية بتاعتهم وراحوا السوق الكبير في القاهرة.
examples.english: They got into their car and went to the big market in Cairo.
examples.transliteration: Rakbou el 3arabeya beta3ethom we rahou el soo2 el kebir fi el Qahera.

examples.arabic: أحمد راح السوق الكبير في القاهرة امبارح.
examples.english: Ahmed went to the big market in Cairo yesterday.
examples.transliteration: Ahmed rah el sooq el kebir fel Qahera embareh.

examples.arabic: كنت مبسوط اوي بس قلت انا اسف على التاخير
examples.english: I was very happy but I said I am sorry for the delay.
examples.transliteration: Kont mabsout awy bas olt ana asef ala el takheer.

examples.arabic: انا قلت انا اسف على التاخير
examples.english: I said I am sorry for the delay.
examples.transliteration: Ana olt ana asef ala el takheer.

examples.arabic: هو قال انا اسف على التاخير بتاع الكورة
examples.english: He said, 'I'm sorry for the ball's delay'.
examples.transliteration: Howa ʾāl ana āsef ʿala et-taʾkhīr betāʿ el-kora.

examples.arabic: اخويا بيشتغل على الكمبيوتر بتاعه والمطر شغال بره
examples.english: My brother works on his computer and the rain is falling outside.
examples.transliteration: Akhouya biyeshtaghal ala el computer betao wel matar shaghal barra.

examples.arabic: النور في الصالة مش شغال
examples.english: The light in the living room is not working.
examples.transliteration: el noor fi el sala mish shaghghal

examples.arabic: التلفزيون قديم ومش شغال
examples.english: The TV is old and not working.
examples.transliteration: El televisyoun qadeem we mish shaghghal.

examples.arabic: هي سألتني تفتكر مين هيكسب وهل رئيس الجمهورية الحالي هيترشح تاني
examples.english: She asked me "Who do you think will win and will the current President of the Republic run again?"
examples.transliteration: Heyya saʾaletni "Teftiker mīn hayeksab w hal raʾīs el-gomhūrīya el-ḥāli hayetrashshaḥ tāni?"

examples.arabic: العم محمود جاب حبل طويل.
examples.english: Uncle Mahmoud brought a long rope.
examples.transliteration: El 3am Ma7moud gab 7abl tawil.
examples.storyTitle: Karim's Ball and the Neighborhood Friends

examples.arabic: المشكلة دي ليها تاريخ طويل من سنين كتيرة.
examples.english: This problem has a long history from many years ago.
examples.transliteration: El-moshkila di liha tarikh tawil min sinin ketira.
examples.storyTitle: War News on the Day of Eid

examples.arabic: بعد يوم طويل انا لسه جايبه تفاح انهارده الصبح وانا مروحه البيت
examples.english: After a long day, I had just bought apples this morning on my way home
examples.transliteration: ba'd yom tawil ana lessa gayba toffah ennaharda essobh wana marawaha el bet
examples.storyTitle: A Day at Work and Home

examples.arabic: هما عاوزين كل الناس تكون سعيدة في اليوم ده
examples.english: They want all the people to be happy on that day.
examples.transliteration: Homa aawzin kol el nas takoun sa'eeda fi el yom dah.

examples.arabic: قطتها اسمها "مشمش" ولونها أبيض زي الثلج.
examples.english: Her cat's name is "Meshmesh" and its color is white like snow.
examples.transliteration: Ottetha esmaha "Meshmesh" we lonha abyad zay el talg.

examples.arabic: إحنا أكلنا ملوخية ورز أبيض.
examples.english: We ate molokhia and white rice.
examples.transliteration: E7na 2akalna molokheya we rozz abyad.
examples.storyTitle: An Egyptian Cooking Day in Our Home

examples.arabic: كنت سعيدة اوي اني سمعت صوتها الحلو
examples.english: I was very happy that I heard her sweet voice.
examples.transliteration: Kunt sa'eeda awi enni sama't sotaha el helw

examples.arabic: أحمد ومنى عيلة صغيرة.
examples.english: Ahmed and Mona are a small family.
examples.transliteration: Ahmad we Mona 3eila soghayara.

examples.arabic: ليلى كانت بنت صغيرة وجميلة أوي.
examples.english: Layla was a very small and beautiful girl.
examples.transliteration: Layla kanet bent soghayara we gamila awi.

examples.arabic: ماما قطعت اللحمة مكعبات صغيرة.
examples.english: Mom cut the meat into small cubes.
examples.transliteration: Mama 2att3at el la7ma moka3abat soghayara.
examples.storyTitle: An Egyptian Cooking Day in Our Home

examples.arabic: ملعبهم كان جنب الجامع القديم.
examples.english: Their playground was next to the old mosque.
examples.transliteration: Mal3abhom kan ganb el game3 el adim.
examples.storyTitle: Karim's Ball and the Neighborhood Friends

examples.arabic: بابا بيشرح إن الوضع صعب أوي و قديم.
examples.english: Dad explains that the situation is very difficult and old.
examples.transliteration: Baba biyishrah in el-wad saab awi wa adeem.
examples.storyTitle: War News on the Day of Eid

examples.arabic: انا شفت صاحبي القديم احمد هناك
examples.english: I saw my old friend Ahmed there.
examples.transliteration: ana shoft sahby el adim ahmed henak

examples.arabic: أنا وصحابي عايزين نشوف المنتخب في الماتش النهائي.
examples.english: My friends and I want to see the national team in the final match.
examples.transliteration: Ana wa sahabi ayzin neshouf el montakhab fel matsh el neha'i.

examples.arabic: بعدين خلص الست شنط التانية في ساعتين بس.
examples.english: Then he finished the other six bags in two hours only.
examples.transliteration: Baaden khallas el-set shonat el-tanya fi saateyn bas.

examples.arabic: ليلى راحت المحل زعلانة شوية
examples.english: Layla went to the shop a little upset
examples.transliteration: Layla rahet el-mahal za'lana shwaya

examples.arabic: كانت زعلانة قوي ومش عارفة تعمل ايه دلوقتي
examples.english: She was very upset and didn't know what to do now.
examples.transliteration: Kanet za'lana 'awee we mesh 'arfa te'mel eh delwa'ti

examples.arabic: لمبة المطبخ مش شغالة ماما زعلانة جدا
examples.english: The kitchen lightbulb isn't working. Mom is very upset.
examples.transliteration: Lombet el-maṭbakh mesh shaghghāla. Mama zaʿlāna geddan.

examples.arabic: كان بيحكيلي عن محل ساندويتشات جديد انا متاكد انها هتعجبك المحل ده مشهور
examples.english: He was telling me about a new sandwich place, I'm sure you will like it; that place is famous.
examples.transliteration: Kan bey7kili 3an ma7all sandwetshat gedeed ana met2akked enaha hat3agebek el-ma7all da mashhoor

examples.arabic: الصحوبية بتبقى أقوى لما بنشارك اللحظات دي مع بعض.
examples.english: Friendship becomes stronger when we share these moments together.
examples.transliteration: El sohobeya beteb'a aqwa lamma bensharek el lahazat di ma'a ba'd.
